description: Gate guard beside the mess building at the former F 4 Frosön. Placed on its pole in 1986; during the lift a strap broke and the aircraft hit the ground damaging the nose. Svensk Flyghistorisk Förening and a dated 2004 on-site photograph record this airframe as 35388 while Swedish Wikipedia records 35386. Recorded as 35388 with 35386 retained as an alias.
aliases: Draken; Saab 35; Saab35; J35; J35D; J35-D; 35386
